Northampton County, Virginia Tax Sales: A Comprehensive Guide

If you’re considering participating in tax sales within Northampton County, Virginia, this guide provides a clear and concise overview to help you navigate the process effectively.​

Understanding Tax Sales in Northampton County

Northampton County conducts tax sales to recover unpaid property taxes. These sales occur as needed and do not follow a fixed annual schedule. To stay informed about upcoming auctions, regularly check the county’s official announcements or consult our Auction Calendar for scheduled events.​

Auction Details

  • Timing: Auction times can vary. Always refer to the official auction notice for the exact schedule.​
  • Registration: Prospective bidders must register before participating. Registration periods differ for each sale, so review the specific auction announcement for deadlines.​
  • Location: The auction venue is specified in the official notice. Ensure you verify the location prior to attending.​

Property Redemption

Property owners have the right to redeem their property by settling all outstanding taxes, penalties, interest, and associated costs before the auction date. Once the property is sold at auction, this redemption option is no longer available.​

Bidding Process

  • Procedure: Properties are awarded to the highest bidder.​
  • Payment Terms: Specific deposit and full payment requirements are detailed in the auction notice. Properties are sold “as-is,” so conducting thorough research before bidding is crucial.​
